instruction.text: Select the words that make up the present perfect tense.

atoms.b: My little sister ((has learnt)) to walk.

end.text:
To form the present perfect tense, you need the helping verb 'have/has' and the past participle form of a verb.

It shows that something happened in the past in an unspecified time.
